oids.description: IP packets that the Citrix ADC attempts to reassemble. If one of the fragments is missing, the whole packet is dropped.

oids.name: ipTotSuccReassembly
oids.description: Fragmented IP packets successfully reassembled on the Citrix ADC.

oids.name: ipTotUnsuccReassembly
oids.description: Packets received that could not be reassembled. This can occur when there is a checksum failure, an identification field mismatch, or when one of the fragments is missing.

oids.name: ipTotTooBig
oids.description: Packets received for which the reassembled data exceeds the Ethernet packet data length of 1500 bytes.

oids.name: ipTotZeroFragmentLen
oids.description: Packets received with a fragment length of 0 bytes.

oids.name: ipTotDupFragments
oids.description: Duplicate IP fragments received. This can occur when the acknowledgement was not received within the expected time.

oids.name: ipTotOutOfOrderFrag
oids.description: Fragments received that are out of order.

oids.name: ipTotUnknownDstRcvd
oids.description: Packets received in which the destination IP address was not reachable or not owned by the Citrix ADC.

oids.name: ipTotBadTransport
oids.description: Packets received in which the protocol specified in the IP header is unknown to the Citrix ADC.

oids.name: ipTotVIPDown
oids.description: Packets received for which the VIP is down. This can occur when all the services bound to the VIP are down or the VIP is manually disabled.

oids.name: ipTotFixHeaderFail
oids.description: Packets received that contain an error in one or more components of the IP header.

oids.name: ipTotAddrLookup
oids.description: IP address lookups performed by the Citrix ADC. When a packet is received on a non-established session, the Citrix ADC checks if the destination IP address is one of the Citrix ADC owned IP addresses.

oids.name: ipTotAddrLookupFail
oids.description: IP address lookups performed by the Citrix ADC that have failed because the destination IP address of the packet does not match any of the Citrix ADC owned IP addresses.

oids.name: ipTotUDPfragmentsFwd
oids.description: UDP fragments forwarded to the client or the server.

oids.name: ipTotTCPfragmentsFwd
oids.description: TCP fragments forwarded to the client or the server.

oids.name: ipTotFragPktsGen
oids.description: Fragmented packets created by the Citrix ADC.

oids.name: ipTotInvalidHeaderSz
oids.description: Packets received in which an invalid data length is specified, or the value in the length field and the actual data length do not match. The range for the Ethernet packet data length is 0-1500 bytes.

oids.name: ipTotInvalidPacketSize
oids.description: Total number of packets received by Citrix ADC with invalid IP packet size.

oids.name: ipTotTruncatedPackets
oids.description: Truncated IP packets received. An overflow in the routers along the path can truncate IP packets.

oids.name: ipTotZeroNextHop
oids.description: Packets received that contain a 0 value in the next hop field. These packets are dropped.

oids.name: ipTotTtlExpired
oids.description: Packets for which the time-to-live (TTL) expired during transit. These packets are dropped.
